description: This file contains implementations for JSON parsing, handling, and environment variable management, including functions to read JSON files, extract values, write pairs to files or environment, and manage JSON objects using cJSON library.

methods.name: int writeItemVal(FILE * fpout,char * pName,char * pVal,int setenvvars)
methods.description: Writes a JSON 'name=value' pair to a file and optionally sets an environment variable.

methods.name: void convertInvalidChars(char * pStr)
methods.description: Converts invalid characters in environment variable names to underscores.

methods.name: size_t getitemval(cJSON * pcitem,char * pOut,size_t szpOutSize)
methods.description: Extracts value from a cJSON item as a string.

methods.name: int SetJsonVars(char * fileIn,char * fileOut,int setenvvars)
methods.description: Reads a JSON file and writes name-value pairs to output file and/or sets environment variables.

methods.name: JSON * ParseJsonStr(char * pJsonStr)
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a cJSON object.

methods.name: int FreeJson(JSON * pJson)
methods.description: Frees a cJSON object created by ParseJsonStr.

methods.name: JSON * GetJsonItem(JSON * pJson,char * pValToGet)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific item from a JSON object by name.

methods.name: size_t GetJsonValFromString(char * pJsonStr,char * pValToGet,char * pOutputVal,size_t maxlen)
methods.description: Gets a JSON value from a string based on a search key.

methods.name: size_t GetJsonVal(JSON * pJson,char * pValToGet,char * pOutputVal,size_t maxlen)
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with a key within a JSON object.

methods.name: size_t GetJsonValContainingFromString(char * pJsonStr,char * pValToGet,char * pOutputVal,size_t maxlen)
methods.description: Searches a JSON string for keys containing a specific substring and retrieves their values.

methods.name: size_t GetJsonValContaining(JSON * pJson,char * pValToGet,char * pOutputVal,size_t maxlen)
methods.description: Searches within a JSON object for keys containing a specific substring and retrieves their values.

methods.name: char * GetJson(char * filename_in)
methods.description: Reads a JSON file and returns its contents as a dynamically allocated string.

methods.name: bool IsJsonArray(JSON * pJson)
methods.description: Checks if a JSON object is an array.

methods.name: unsigned GetJsonArraySize(JSON * pJson)
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in a JSON array.

methods.name: JSON * GetJsonArrayItem(JSON * pJson,unsigned index)
methods.description: Retrieves an item from a JSON array by index.

methods.name: int (*)(FILE * fpout,char * pName,char * pVal,int setenvvars) getwriteItemVal(void)

ctags.name: GetJsonVal
ctags.pattern: /^size_t GetJsonVal( JSON *pJson, char *pValToGet, char *pOutputVal, size_t maxlen )$/

ctags.name: GetJsonValContaining
ctags.pattern: /^size_t GetJsonValContaining( JSON *pJson, char *pValToGet, char *pOutputVal, size_t maxlen )$/

ctags.name: GetJsonValFromString
ctags.pattern: /^size_t GetJsonValFromString( char *pJsonStr, char *pValToGet, char *pOutputVal, size_t maxlen )$/

ctags.name: getitemval
ctags.pattern: /^static size_t getitemval( cJSON *pcitem, char *pOut, size_t szpOutSize )$/

ctags.name: getwriteItemVal
ctags.pattern: /^int (*getwriteItemVal(void))( FILE* fpout, char *pName, char *pVal, int setenvvars ) {$/

ctags.name: writeItemVal
ctags.pattern: /^static int writeItemVal( FILE* fpout, char *pName, char *pVal, int setenvvars )$/
